title: 第10章 新衣服
content_zh:
第10章 新衣服
三月的季节，虽大地回暖，但还是有些冰冷。
若是刚从禁区出来，对于这样的冷不会觉得什么，可如果在外面久了，身体依旧会感受这丝丝入骨的寒。
尤其是夜里，这冰寒就更重一些。
随着寒风吹过，许青身影没有丝毫停顿，只是将身上的皮袄裹的紧了一些。
他还有事情没做完，所以在夜色里于营地内小心的穿梭。
途中看到一些野狗，冲着他呲牙，可与他的目光对望后，似察觉到他身上的血腥气味，纷纷闭嘴，躲了起来。
许青目光从野狗身上挪开，继续前行。
直至到了中环区域一处屋舍后，他蹲在阴暗地一动不动，凝望远处的一栋大屋舍。
那里有熄灭的篝火。
许青记得和马四分开的胖山，就是去了这里，所以他想等等看，对方会不会夜晚起夜外出。
冰冷的寒意侵袭全身，但许青的身影好似石化了一样，定在那里，丝毫不动，耐心的等待。
在他身后，一处建筑的屋顶，此刻七爷与其仆从也跟了过来，看着蹲在那边的许青，七爷笑了。
“果然如我所料，这小狼崽是要赶尽杀绝的节奏。”
“老夫现在很期待，这小子要是进了旁边的禁区，在那里会是什么表现。”七爷一样蹲下，一边感兴趣的观看，一边和身旁的仆从说道。
仆从含笑，蹲在七爷的旁边，打量远处的许青。
眼看时间流逝，过去了半个时辰，许青眉头微微皱起。
他想了想后，转身顺着阴暗处离开，整个人如同一个幽灵，无声无息的来，毫无声息的走。
没有立刻回雷队的居所，而是在附近绕了一圈。
确定无人跟随后，许青这才一晃钻入雷队的院子，悄无声息回到自己的小屋。

进来后，他深吸口气，搓了搓手，似要将身体的寒借助这个动作驱散。
接着他擦拭了一下身上的血迹，这才盘膝坐在床板上，眼睛里露出思索。
“这些拾荒者都需不定时的接活外出，且马四好色，所以只要时间不久，应该不会有人察觉他的死亡，胖山大概率也不会因此警惕。”
“但为了稳妥，还是要尽快干掉胖山才是。”许青眯起眼。
如当初杀残牛一样，在贫民窟长大的他，不允许身边有威胁自己生命的隐患。
杀马四，是因对方抢自己物品又威胁，准备对付胖山，也是这个原因。
沉吟后许青从皮袋里翻出马四的物品，仔细检查一番。
大都是杂物，还有一个巴掌大的铁块，没什么出奇，像是一个材料。
除此之外，还有七十多枚灵币，这对许青来说已经是一笔巨款了。
他仔细的数了一遍，又将白丹拿出，把自己的白丹与马四的对比后，发现这些白丹都是质地不新鲜的样子。
于是他心底对于杂货铺店家所说，信了七分。
思索一番，许青取出一枚放在嘴边吞了下去，随后闭上眼默默感受。
很快他就感受到一股暖流在体内升腾，最终汇聚在了左手臂的异化点上，泛起舒服之感。
半晌后，当这感觉消失，许青睁开眼立刻看向左臂，那里的两个异化点略微淡了一些，刺痛感也少了些许。
“有作用。”许青目露喜色，拿出第二枚吞下。
同样的感觉继续浮现，直至再次消散，他的刺痛感也随之消失。
全身升起一股清灵之意，很舒服，仿佛血肉都被洗涤了一番，使得许青觉得自己的速度与力量，仿佛更强了一些。
剩下的白丹，他没有继续服用，放在皮袋内，闭上眼开始修行。
一夜无话。
第二天一早，许青睁开眼，起身外出。

刚刚推开屋舍的门，他就看到雷队在院子里盘膝，好似在吐纳。
许青没去打扰，轻轻的
今天的风似比昨夜还要冷，吹在身上不但让人颤抖，甚至就连那些野狗，也都缩在洞中很少外出。
许青呼吸间能看到雾气出现，这让他脑海泛起一些在贫民窟时不好的回忆。
他讨厌寒冷。
因为寒冷对于一个风餐露宿的流浪儿而言，就是一场劫难，需要用力的挣扎才可以活下去。
所以，在这冰冷中路过一处服装铺的许青，脚步不由自主的顿了一下，看向铺子里挂着的厚厚且干净的衣物。
他摸了摸鼓鼓的皮袋，转身走了进去。
铺子内没几个人，许青进来看向那些挂着的衣服，看的很认真。
一旁柜子处，店家扫了许青一眼，没太在意，与身边的伙计吩咐。
“你去后面整理一下，把那些过了一个月没回来取的定制衣物，拿出来挂着卖掉吧。”
“那要是定衣服的人回来怎么办？”伙计似乎新来不久，迟疑了一下。
“回来？营地内每隔一段时间都有人失踪，有的死在禁区里，有的莫名其妙消失了，能回来的只有鬼，快去。”
店家不耐烦的挥手，伙计赶紧向后堂跑去。
不久，在许青还没选好衣物时，伙计已经抱着大量衣物出来，一一挂上后，许青一眼就看中了一件深色的翻毛皮衣。
那是别人订制，却再也无法回来取走的衣服。
一炷香后，当许青从铺子内走出时，他的身上穿着的，就是那件深色的翻毛皮衣。
这衣服隔寒且不厚重，穿在身上暖和的程度超过许青之前的衣服太多。
唯独就是因他瘦小，所以在身上如同大衣一般，很不协调。
但许青很开心，走在路上他小心的避开了一些脏的地方。

正要去寻找胖山时，他注意到营地外，此刻有杂乱声传来，同时营地内的拾荒者，也有很多都走出，目有期待靠近传来声响的方向。
许青也抬头看去。
渐渐他看到阳光辉映下，一个足足十多辆马车的车队，浩浩荡荡的驶向这里。
其上坐着的人，哪怕只是侍卫也都衣着无比光鲜，面色红润，目中更有精芒，且大都身体上有惊人的灵能波动。
至于车厢内的，许青看不到，但也能猜测出必定是身份很尊贵之人。
如这样的车队，许青听雷队说起过，似乎经常会来到营地，或是行商，或是为了采购炼制白丹的七叶草。
而胖山的身影，也在人群中出现，吸引了许青的注意后，他不再关注车队，而是眯起眼，盯着胖山，开始了跟随。
只是或许是车队的到来，这一整天营地内都很热闹，形成了集市，许青始终没有找到机会。
直至深夜，他看着胖山再次回到了那处大屋舍内，于是将袖子里的匕首收了起来，转身离去。
虽这一天没有机会出手，但许青耐心很足，回到小屋后他穿着新买的衣服打坐修行，即便是睡觉时也不脱下。
直至再一次天亮后，准备继续外出寻找机会的他，才爱惜的脱下那件翻毛大衣，又换上了自己的破皮袄。
看着新衣服，许青觉得自己昨天有些鲁莽了。
此刻穿着破皮袄，许青走在营地内，路过人群不少的集市，目光看似打量车队的驻扎处，但实际上是在寻找胖山的身影。
远处，七爷打着哈气，与仆从坐在一处房顶，目光扫过车队，又看向许青，随意的向身边仆从问了句。
“帖子给柏大师送去了么？”
“七爷，已经送去了，但柏大师说他最近身体抱恙……”
“抱恙？他就是医师，他这是……咦，这小子昨天我记得穿了件新衣服，怎么今天又换回去了？”七爷正说着，注意到了许青的衣服，诧异了一下。
七爷费解时，许青在人群内，余光锁定了胖山。
就这样，在许青的余光锁定下，一整天过去。
随着深夜的到来，那原本要走回屋舍的胖山，不知为何改变了方向，竟在这夜色里，向着外环区域走去。

那里相对来说，有些偏僻。
“发现我了？”许青眉头一皱，眼睛眯了起来，目中渐渐更为冰冷。
他没有跟随，而是打量四周，直至确定对方只是一人前往后，才绕了一个方位，于暗处潜行，提前胖山到了外环。
确定这里没有埋伏，他眼睛里寒芒更浓，藏在了暗处。
而此刻，胖山也走到了这片范围，脚步忽然停下。
“小崽子，我昨天就察觉有人跟踪，出来吧，这里很偏，适合处理你的尸体，你若不敢出来，下一次可就不是我单独一人了，就算雷队护着你，我们血影也一样能让你付出代价。”
许青眼睛眯起，对方话语都说到这份上了，也没有藏着的必要，于是从暗处走出。
“马四不是偷偷接活外出，是你弄死的吧，倒是小看了你。”胖山狞笑，看向走出的许青。
“但无妨，我本就看他不顺眼很久，你不弄死，我也打算下次外出时弄死他，所以还要谢谢你呢，而他死活我不管，但他皮袋里的某样东西，应该在你那里吧。”
胖山看向许青腰部的口袋，眼中有贪婪之意，不等许青回答，身体一晃，其胖圆的身体竟爆发出超越凝气二层的速度。
身体上的灵能波动，在这一刻也都强了不少，甚至在体外形成了一层术法气流，带动寒风，整个人如一个冰球，撞向许青。
他不是凝气二层，此刻的灵能波动，已然达到了三层。
也正因如此，再加上窥伺马四皮袋里的一样东西，他才独自外出。
许青眼睛眯起，他第一次与修士正面交战，尤其是对方的身体外气流显然是灵能所化，但他相信自己的力量与速度。
于是在对方到来的瞬间，许青猛地冲出，全力爆发下的速度，使其身影几乎留下了一些残痕。
眨眼间就避开胖山的身躯，在胖山明显一愣中，许青已到了其身后，右手抬起一样是全力爆发，一拳轰出。
这是许青首次用出全部战力，这一拳的打出直接掀起了啪啪之响，落在胖山身后时，发出了砰的一声。
胖山整个人剧烈的颤抖，体外气流形成的壁障寸寸碎裂，体内五脏翻滚，鲜血哇的一声喷出时，许青眼睛里杀机已浓。
右手抬起时铁签出现，身体一晃从胖山踉跄后退的身侧顷刻而过，铁签顺势就要刺入胖山的头部。
但下一瞬，许青面色微变，身体急速倒退。

就在他退后的刹那，胖山目中露出阴辣之芒。
两道黑线赫然从其耳中钻出，一前一后带着尖锐的呼啸直奔许青面部而去。
那两条黑线是黑色的带翅蜈蚣，速度极快，眼看就要临近，被许青左手抽出的匕首，直接一一斩断。
最后那只，被斩断时距离许青的眼睛，只有不到七寸之远。
这凶险的一幕，让许青眼睛里杀机更浓，再次冲去。
而借助许青之前退后的时机，胖山体内的五脏翻滚也恢复了一些。
此刻他圆滚滚的身体急速倒退，双手更是抬起掐诀，其面部瞬间涨红，直接向冲来许青喷出一口毒雾。
雾气翻滚，范围很大，向着许青飞速卷去，所过之处地面都传来滋滋之声，可见毒性浓烈。
做完这些，胖山面色苍白，肚子都小了一圈，再次倒退，目中既有狠辣，也有心悸。
许青的强悍，出乎他的意料之外。
他没想到凭着自己凝气三层，且一身毒攻，居然都差点被对方一击必杀。
而这口毒雾，已是他的杀手锏之术，若还是不能奈何对方，自己就必须要呼喊，使对方忌惮。
只是呼喊的话，马四的那件物品，自己怕是很难获得。
而他这里其实还有一样禁物没去使用，此物副作用极大，可还是被他取出，那是一个琥珀。
心中迟疑间，他看向被雾气弥漫的许青所在区域。
可就在他看去的瞬间，雾气向着四周猛烈卷开，其内许青的身影刹那冲出。
速度之快使胖山眼前一花，内心咯噔，右手刚要捏碎琥珀，口中也要呼喊，但却晚了。
一根乌黑色的铁签，带着无比的锋芒，瞬息到来，势如破竹，从其头部刹那贯穿，鲜血溅出，落在了其旁许青的身上。
胖山身体一僵，想要转头但却做不到，尸体缓缓倒下，一动不动。
没去看胖山的尸体，许青气喘吁吁警惕观察四周。

此地偏僻，确定没有引起关注后，他快速靠近胖山的尸体，取走对方皮袋。
正要用毒牙刺去，但许青注意到胖山右手似乎抓着什么东西，于是掰开对方手指，看到了一块已经碎裂大半的琥珀。
此物看似如常，没什么出奇之处，唯独其内封着一根蝎尾。
许青小心取走，将尸体如法炮制一番，等这尸身化作血水后，飞速离去。
一边走，他一边擦去身上的血迹，消失在了夜色里。
七爷与其仆从，此刻从黑暗里走出。
望着许青消失的地方，七爷似对刚刚许青与胖山的交战，不是很在意，而是思索一番，露出恍然大悟的表情。
“我知道了，那小子不穿新衣服，是怕沾了血啊，他这是穷怕了，心疼衣服。”
一旁的仆从也舒了口气。
这一整天，七爷都在思索那小子为何不穿新衣服，此刻终于有了答案，也就不用自己每次听到，都要去琢磨原因了。
虽然是两章更新，可实际上都是大章，本章快4500字，下一章也近4000字呢。
其实可以拆成3章，但我觉得没有那个必要，会破坏章节的完整。
希望我的诚意，大家可以感受到，谢谢兄弟姐妹的支持。
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 10 New Clothes
In March, although the earth is getting warmer, it is still a bit cold.
If you have just come out of the restricted area, you will not feel anything about the cold, but if you have been outside for a long time, your body will still feel the coldness that penetrates your bones.
Especially at night, the cold is even heavier.
As the cold wind blew by, Xu Qing's figure did not pause at all, but he just wrapped his leather jacket tighter.
He still had some unfinished business, so he walked carefully through the camp in the night.
On the way, he saw some wild dogs baring their teeth at him, but after meeting his eyes, they seemed to sense the smell of blood on his body, so they all shut up and hid.
Xu Qing looked away from the wild dog and continued to move forward.
Until he arrived at a house in the Central area, he squatted motionless in the darkness, staring at a large house in the distance.
There was an extinguished campfire.
Xu Qing remembered that Pang Shan, who was separated from Ma Si, went here, so he wanted to wait and see if the other party would get up and go out at night.
An icy chill invaded the whole body, but Xu Qing's figure seemed to be petrified, standing there, not moving at all, waiting patiently.
Behind him, on the roof of a building, Master Qi and his servants also followed him. Looking at Xu Qing squatting there, Master Qi smiled.
"As I expected, this little wolf cub is going to kill everyone."
"I'm looking forward to seeing what this kid will do if he enters the restricted area next to him." Master Qi squatted down and watched with interest while talking to the servant beside him.
The servant smiled, squatted next to Master Qi, and looked at Xu Qing in the distance.
Seeing the passage of time, half an hour passed, Xu Qing frowned slightly.
After thinking for a while, he turned around and left along the dark place. He was like a ghost, coming and leaving without a sound.
He didn't immediately return to Team Lei's residence, but walked around in a circle.
After confirming that no one was following him, Xu Qing slipped into the courtyard of the Thunder Team and quietly returned to his hut.
After coming in, he took a deep breath and rubbed his hands, as if to dispel the cold in his body with this action.
Then he wiped the blood on his body, then sat cross-legged on the bed, thinking in his eyes.
"These scavengers need to go out from time to time to pick up work, and Ma Si is a lustful person, so as long as it doesn't take long, no one will notice his death, and there is a high probability that Fatshan will not be alerted by it."
"But to be on the safe side, we still have to kill Pang Shan as soon as possible." Xu Qing narrowed his eyes.
Just like when he killed and mutilated the cow, he grew up in a slum and did not allow hidden dangers that threatened his life around him.
The reason why Ma Si was killed was because the other party was robbing him of his belongings and threatening him, and he was preparing to deal with Fat Mountain. This was also the reason.
After pondering, Xu Qing took out Ma Si's belongings from his leather bag and inspected them carefully.
Most of them were sundries, and there was also a palm-sized piece of iron, nothing surprising, just like a piece of material.
In addition, there are more than seventy spirit coins, which is already a huge sum of money for Xu Qing.
He counted it carefully and took out the white pills. After comparing his own white pills with Ma Si's, he found that the texture of these white pills was stale.
So in his heart, he believed what the grocery store store said.
After thinking for a while, Xu Qing took one out, put it to his mouth and swallowed it, then closed his eyes and felt it silently.
Soon he felt a warm current rising in his body, and finally converged on the alienation point on his left arm, giving him a feeling of comfort.
After a while, when the feeling disappeared, Xu Qing opened his eyes and immediately looked at his left arm. The two alienation points there were slightly lighter, and the tingling sensation was also lessened.
"It works." Xu Qing's eyes were filled with joy as he took out the second one and swallowed it.
The same feeling continued to resurface until it dissipated again, taking his tingling sensation away with it.
A sense of purity arose throughout the body, and it felt very comfortable, as if all the flesh and blood had been washed, making Xu Qing feel comfortable.His speed and strength seemed to be stronger.
He did not continue to take the remaining white elixir, but put it in a leather bag, closed his eyes and began to practice.
A night of silence.
Early the next morning, Xu Qing opened her eyes and got up to go out.
As soon as he opened the door of the house, he saw Captain Lei sitting cross-legged in the yard, as if he was vomiting.
Xu Qing didn't bother, and gently
Today's wind seems to be even colder than last night. Not only does it make people shiver when it blows on them, but even the wild dogs huddle in their holes and rarely go out.
Xu Qing could see the mist appearing as he breathed, which brought back some bad memories of his time in the slums.
He hates the cold.
Because the cold is a disaster for a homeless child sleeping in the open air, and he needs to struggle hard to survive.
Therefore, Xu Qing, who was passing by a clothing store in this cold weather, paused involuntarily and looked at the thick and clean clothes hanging in the store.
He touched the bulging leather bag, turned around and walked in.
There were not many people in the shop, so Xu Qing came in and looked at the hanging clothes, looking at them seriously.
At the cabinet on the side, the storekeeper glanced at Xu Qing, didn't pay much attention, and gave instructions to the waiter beside him.
"Go to the back and sort it out. Take out the custom-made clothes that you haven't come back to pick up after a month, hang them up and sell them."
"Then what if the person who ordered the clothes comes back?" The waiter seemed to be new and hesitated for a moment.
"Come back? People disappear every once in a while in the camp. Some die in the restricted area, and some disappear inexplicably. The only ones who can come back are ghosts. Go quickly."
The store owner waved impatiently, and the waiter hurriedly ran to the back hall.
Soon, before Xu Qing had chosen the clothes, the clerk had already come out with a large amount of clothes. After hanging them up one by one, Xu Qing took a fancy to a dark fur coat at a glance.
Those were clothes that were ordered by others but could never be picked up again.
After burning the incense, when Xu Qing walked out of the shop, he was wearing the dark fur coat.
This clothes is cold-proof and not heavy. It is much warmer than Xu Qing's previous clothes.
But because he is so thin, it looks like a coat on his body, which is very uncoordinated.
But Xu Qing was very happy. He carefully avoided some dirty places while walking on the road.
When he was about to look for Fat Mountain, he noticed a chaotic sound coming from outside the camp. At the same time, many scavengers in the camp also walked out, looking forward to approaching the direction of the sound.
Xu Qing also looked up.
Gradually, he saw under the sunlight, a convoy of more than ten carriages, heading here in a mighty manner.
The people sitting on it, even the guards, were all dressed in extremely bright clothes, with rosy complexions and bright eyes, and most of them had astonishing spiritual energy fluctuations in their bodies.
As for the person in the carriage, Xu Qing couldn't see it, but he could guess that he must be a very distinguished person.
Xu Qing had heard from Team Lei that convoys like this would often come to the camp, either to do business or to purchase horse chestnuts for refining white pills.
Fat Shan's figure also appeared in the crowd. After attracting Xu Qing's attention, he no longer paid attention to the convoy. Instead, he narrowed his eyes, stared at Fat Shan, and started to follow.
Perhaps it was because of the arrival of the convoy that the camp was very lively all day long, forming a market, but Xu Qing never found a chance.
Until late at night, he watched Fat Shan return to the big house again, so he put away the dagger in his sleeve and turned around to leave.
Although there was no chance to take action that day, Xu Qing was very patient. After returning to the hut, he meditated in the newly bought clothes and did not take them off even when sleeping.
It wasn't until dawn again that he was ready to go out to look for opportunities. He took off his fur coat and put on his own ragged leather jacket.
Looking at the new clothes, Xu Qing felt that she was a little reckless yesterday.
Wearing a torn leather jacket, Xu Qing was walking in the camp, passing by the crowdIn many markets, people seem to be looking at where the motorcade is stationed, but in fact they are looking for Fat Shan.
In the distance, Master Qi was taking a deep breath, sitting on a roof with his servants. He glanced at the motorcade, then looked at Xu Qing, and casually asked the servants beside him.
"Did you send the post to Master Bai?"
"Master Qi, we have already sent him away, but Master Bai said that he has been ill recently..."
"Are you sick? He is a doctor. He is... Hey, I remember this kid wore new clothes yesterday. Why did he change back again today?" As Master Qi was talking, he noticed Xu Qing's clothes and was surprised.
While Qi Ye was puzzled, Xu Qing was in the crowd and locked onto Pang Shan with his peripheral vision.
In this way, with Xu Qing's peripheral vision locked in, the whole day passed.
With the arrival of late night, Fat Shan, who was originally going to walk back to his house, changed his direction for some reason and walked towards the outer ring area in the night.
It's relatively remote there.
"Did you find me?" Xu Qing frowned, his eyes narrowed, and his eyes gradually became colder.
He did not follow, but looked around, until he was sure that the other party was going alone, then he took a detour, sneaked in the dark, and reached the outer ring ahead of schedule.
After confirming that there was no ambush here, the cold light in his eyes became stronger and he hid in the darkness.
At this moment, Fat Shan also reached this area, and his footsteps suddenly stopped.
"Baby, I noticed someone was following you yesterday. Come out. This place is very remote and suitable for disposing of your body. If you don't dare to come out, I won't be alone next time. Even if the Thunder Team protects you, we Blood Shadow can still make you pay the price."
Xu Qing narrowed his eyes. The other party's words had reached this point, and there was no need to hide it, so he walked out of the darkness.
"Ma Si didn't go out secretly to pick up work. You killed him, right? He underestimated you." Fat Shan smiled evilly and looked at Xu Qing who walked out.
"But it doesn't matter. I've disliked him for a long time. If you don't kill him, I plan to kill him next time I go out, so I want to thank you. I don't care if he lives or lives, but something in his bag should be with you."
Fat Shan looked at the pocket on Xu Qing's waist with greed in his eyes. Without waiting for Xu Qing's reply, his body swayed, and his fat and round body exploded at a speed that exceeded the second level of Qi Condensation.
The spiritual energy fluctuations in his body became much stronger at this moment, and even formed a layer of magical airflow outside the body, driving the cold wind, and the whole person was like an ice ball, crashing into Xu Qing.
He was not at the second level of Qi Condensation, but his spiritual energy fluctuations at this moment had already reached the third level.
It was precisely because of this and the fact that he was spying on something in Ma Si's leather bag that he went out alone.
Xu Qing narrowed his eyes. It was his first time fighting a monk head-on, especially since the air flow outside the opponent's body was obviously transformed by spiritual energy, but he believed in his own strength and speed.
So at the moment when the opponent arrived, Xu Qing rushed out suddenly, and his full burst of speed almost left some traces on his figure.
In the blink of an eye, he avoided Fat Shan's body. When Fat Shan was obviously stunned, Xu Qing was already behind him. He raised his right hand and punched out with all his strength.
This was the first time that Xu Qing used all his fighting power. The punch made a snapping sound, and when it landed behind Pangshan, there was a bang.
Pang Shan's whole body trembled violently, the barrier formed by the airflow outside his body was shattered inch by inch, his internal organs were tumbling, and when blood spurted out with a loud sound, Xu Qing's eyes were filled with murderous intent.
When he raised his right hand, the iron stick appeared. His body swayed past Pang Shan's staggering back body, and the iron stick was about to pierce Pang Shan's head.
But in the next moment, Xu Qing's complexion changed slightly and his body quickly retreated.
The moment he stepped back, Fatty Shan's eyes revealed a sinister look.
Two black lines suddenly emerged from his ears, one after the other with a sharp whistling and heading straight towards Xu Qing's face.
Those two black lines are black winged centipedes. They are extremely fast and are about to be approached.Qing drew the dagger with his left hand and cut them off one by one.
The last one was less than seven inches away from Xu Qing's eyes when it was cut off.
This dangerous scene made Xu Qing's eyes more murderous and he rushed forward again.
And with the help of Xu Qing's opportunity to retreat, the tumbling internal organs in Pang Shan's body also recovered a little.
At this moment, his round body quickly retreated, and he raised his hands to make a seal. His face instantly turned red, and he sprayed a mouthful of poisonous mist directly towards Xu Qing who was rushing towards him.
The mist rolled over a large area and quickly rolled towards Xu Qing. There was a sizzling sound from the ground wherever it passed, indicating that it was highly toxic.
After doing this, Fat Shan's face turned pale and his belly became smaller. He fell back again, with a look of cruelty and palpitations in his eyes.
Xu Qing's strength was beyond his expectation.
He didn't expect that with his third level of Qi Condensation and his poison attack, he was almost killed by the opponent in one blow.
And this poisonous mist is already his trump card. If he still can't do anything to the other party, he must shout to make the other party afraid.
If he just shouted, it would be difficult for him to obtain Ma Si's item.
There was actually another forbidden item that he had not used here. This item had extremely side effects, but he still took it out. It was amber.
Hesitating in his heart, he looked towards the area where Xu Qing was filled with mist.
But the moment he looked, the mist rolled away violently, and Xu Qing's figure rushed out of it.
The speed made Pang Shan's eyes blurred, and his heart was pounding. He was about to crush the amber with his right hand, and he wanted to shout, but it was too late.
A jet-black iron stick, with an incomparable edge, arrived in an instant, with the force of breaking a bamboo, it penetrated through his head in an instant, and blood spattered out, falling on Xu Qing's body next to him.
Pang Shan's body froze. He wanted to turn his head but couldn't. The body slowly fell down and remained motionless.
Without looking at Fat Shan's body, Xu Qing panted and looked around carefully.
The place was remote and after making sure it did not attract attention, he quickly approached Fat Shan's body and took away the opponent's leather bag.
Just as he was about to stab it with his fangs, Xu Qing noticed that Pang Shan seemed to be holding something in his right hand, so he opened his fingers and saw a piece of amber that had been mostly broken into pieces.
This object looks normal, there is nothing surprising about it, except that there is a scorpion tail sealed inside.
Xu Qing took it away carefully, processed the corpse in the same way, and left quickly after the corpse turned into blood.
As he walked, he wiped the blood off his body and disappeared into the night.
The seventh master and his servants walked out of the darkness at this moment.
Looking at the place where Xu Qing disappeared, Qi Ye didn't seem to care much about the battle between Xu Qing and Pang Shan just now. Instead, he thought about it and showed an expression of sudden realization.
"I understand. That boy doesn't wear new clothes because he's afraid of getting stained with blood. He's afraid of poverty and feels sorry for his clothes."
The servants on the side also breathed a sigh of relief.
Throughout the whole day, Qi Ye had been thinking about why the boy didn't wear new clothes. Now he finally had the answer, so he didn't have to figure out the reason every time he heard it.
